topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: Found Eliza's hidden paper, scrawled with dreams she’s never shared. Lists of far places and grand deeds, like pilgrimages to holy sites where saints perform their miracles. I read of cities built on rivers and mountains reaching to the sky. Her heart set on seeing the world’s wonders, though we’ve never left the valley’s bounds. It’s a strange thing, liking the idea of her wanting more than we’ve known. I’ll keep this paper safe, as if it’s a seed sown in the winter, waiting for the warmth to sprout. Maybe I’ll ask her what it means, this bucket list, and how we can turn her dreams into our path forward.
